captions.detailed: A 3D model of a circular sewing button with a smooth, rounded outer rim and a depressed central well. The center of the button features four small, symmetrically arranged circular holes for thread. Each hole has a smooth, spherical indentation surrounding its top and bottom openings, creating a soft, recessed transition into the button body.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, 3D-printable circular button with customizable scale and outer radius. The button should feature a rounded top and bottom profile, a central cylindrical core, and four thread holes arranged in a square pattern, each surrounded by a spherical indentation on both the top and bottom faces.
captions.factory: The script uses a scale transform to control the overall button scale. The button body is constructed by unioning a central flat cylinder with two identical, mirrored halves, each formed by differencing a tapered cylinder and a large sphere to create a convex, rounded outer surface. Four thread holes are subtracted using cylinders, and their smooth entries are created by subtracting spheres from both the top and bottom faces of the button.
